\u27e6CODE15\u27e7: ["      ```python", "      from pydantic import BaseModel, SerializerFunctionWrapHandler, model_serializer", "", "", "      class UserModel(BaseModel):", "          username: str", "          password: str", "", "          @model_serializer(mode='wrap')", "          def serialize_model(", "              self, handler: SerializerFunctionWrapHandler", "          ) -> dict[str, object]:", "              serialized = handler(self)", "              serialized['fields'] = list(serialized)", "              return serialized", "", "", "      print(UserModel(username='foo', password='bar').model_dump())", "      #> {'username': 'foo', 'password': 'bar', 'fields': ['username', 'password']}", "      ```"]
\u27e6CODE16\u27e7: ["```python", "from pydantic import BaseModel, FieldSerializationInfo, field_serializer", "", "", "class Model(BaseModel):", "    text: str", "", "    @field_serializer('text', mode='plain')", "    @classmethod", "    def remove_stopwords(cls, v: str, info: FieldSerializationInfo) -> str:", "        if isinstance(info.context, dict):", "            stopwords = info.context.get('stopwords', set())", "            v = ' '.join(w for w in v.split() if w.lower() not in stopwords)", "        return v", "", "", "model = Model(text='This is an example document')", "print(model.model_dump())  # no context", "#> {'text': 'This is an example document'}", "print(model.model_dump(context={'stopwords': ['this', 'is', 'an']}))", "#> {'text': 'example document'}", "```"]
